'''Dalzana''' was the western residential district of [[Sernpidal City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]]. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doel Scherp]] owned an [[Scherp's Estate|estate]] in Dalzana.
